desc: The Frigidaire 30" Gas Range with Air Fry allows you to get that same great taste and crispy texture of deep frying with little to no oil, right in your oven. Plus, this cooktop features five burners to satisfy all of your cooking needs, including a 5,000-BTU simmer burner for delicate foods, a 10,000-BTU center oval burner perfect for griddles or larger pans, and our powerful 18K BTU Quick Boil Burner, so you can get meals on the table, faster.
hl: Get faster, more even baking results with our fan convection baking system.
Designed to meet all of your cooking needs with a 5,000-BTU simmer burner, 10,000-BTU center oval burner, and 18,000-BTU Quick Boil Burner.
Experience faster boil times and more powerful cooking with the 18,000 BTU burner.
Cleaning your cooktop is easier with removable, dishwasher safe burner caps.
Moving heavy pots and pans across the cooktop is easier with continuous edge-to-edge grates.
Redesigned to be even wider - allowing you to store any unused oven racks, baking trays and more!
